freq.Description: Frequency for which the intensity of the transient-evoked otoacoustic emission is reported.

oae.Description: Amplitude of the transient-evoked otoacoustic emissions at a specific frequency.

noise.Description: Measured level of the noise relative strength.

snr.Description: Difference between the measured level of the transient-evoked otoacoustic emissions and the measured noise relative strength (TEOAE level - Noise level).

confidence.Description: Level of confidence linked to the obtained signal-to-noise ratio.
